defmodule CiPipeline.WebController do use Plug.Router require Logger @max_retries 3 @rate_limit_window 60_000 @rate_limit_max 100 @frame_ancestors "'self'" plug :match plug :dispatch plug CiPipeline.RateLimiter # Security headers module defmodule SecurityHeaders do @behaviour Plug @default_policies %{ "X-Content-Type-Options" => "nosniff", "X-XSS-Protection" => "1; mode=block", "Referrer-Policy" => "strict-origin-when-cross-origin", "Permissions-Policy" => "camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=()" } def init(opts), do: opts def call(conn, opts) do frame_policy = Keyword.get(opts, :frame_policy, :deny) csp_ancestors = Keyword.get(opts, :csp_ancestors, "'none'") headers = build_headers(frame_policy, csp_ancestors) Enum.reduce(headers, conn, fn {key, value}, acc -> Plug.Conn.put_resp_header(acc, key, value) end) end defp build_headers(frame_policy, csp_ancestors) do base = Map.to_list(@default_policies) frame_header = x_frame_options_value(frame_policy) csp = content_security_policy(csp_ancestors) [{"X-Frame-Options", frame_header} | base] ++ [{"Content-Security-Policy", csp}] end defp x_frame_options_value(:deny), do: "DENY" defp x_frame_options_value(:sameorigin), do: "SAMEORIGIN" defp x_frame_options_value(_), do: "DENY" defp content_security_policy(ancestors) do "default-src 'self'; frame-ancestors #{ancestors}" end end # Rate limiter with retry logic defmodule RateLimiter do @behaviour Plug @bucket_interval 60_000 @max_requests 100 def init(opts), do: opts def call(conn, _opts) do client_ip = conn.remote_ip |> Tuple.to_list() |> Enum.join(".") case check_rate(client_ip) do :ok -> conn :rate_limited -> conn |> Plug.Conn.put_resp_header("Retry-After", "60") |> Plug.Conn.send_resp(429, "Rate limited. Retry after 60 seconds.") |> Plug.Conn.halt() end end defp check_rate(client_ip) do key = "rate:#{client_ip}" case :ets.lookup(:rate_limits, key) do [{^key, count, window_start}] -> now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) if now - window_start > @bucket_interval do :ets.insert(:rate_limits, {key, 1, now}) :ok else if count >= @max_requests, do: :rate_limited, else: ( :ets.insert(:rate_limits, {key, count + 1, window_start}) :ok ) end [] -> now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) :ets.insert(:rate_limits, {key, 1, now}) :ok end end end # Pipeline trigger with retry defmodule PipelineExecutor do @max_retries 3 @base_delay 1000 def trigger_build(params, attempt \\ 1) do case do_trigger(params) do {:ok, result} -> {:ok, result} {:error, reason} when attempt < @max_retries -> delay = @base_delay * :math.pow(2, attempt - 1) |> round() Process.sleep(delay) Logger.warn("Retry attempt #{attempt} for build trigger: #{reason}") trigger_build(params, attempt + 1) {:error, reason} -> {:error, :max_retries_exceeded, reason} end end defp do_trigger(params) do # Simulate CI trigger if Map.has_key?(params, "repo") and Map.has_key?(params, "branch") do {:ok, %{build_id: :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(8) |> Base.hex_encode32()}} else {:error, "missing required parameters"} end end end # Dashboard endpoint - serves the CI pipeline UI get "/dashboard" do conn |> apply_security_context(:dashboard) |> put_resp_content_type("text/html") |> send_resp(200, render_dashboard()) end # API endpoint for triggering builds post "/api/trigger" do {:ok, body, conn} = Plug.Conn.read_body(conn) params = Jason.decode!(body) conn = apply_security_context(conn, :api) case PipelineExecutor.trigger_build(params) do {:ok, result} -> conn |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(result)) {:error, :max_retries_exceeded, reason} -> conn |> send_resp(503, Jason.encode!(%{error: reason})) end end # Webhook endpoint for external integrations get "/webhook/status" do conn |> apply_security_context(:webhook) |> send_resp(200, Jason.encode!(%{status: "healthy"})) end # The security context application - note the frame policy derivation defp apply_security_context(conn, context) do {frame_policy, csp_ancestors} = security_policy_for(context) SecurityHeaders.call(conn, frame_policy: frame_policy, csp_ancestors: csp_ancestors) end # Policy resolution - the frame_ancestors for :dashboard context # is derived from module attribute @frame_ancestors which is "'self'" # However, X-Frame-Options uses :sameorigin which browsers may # interpret differently than CSP frame-ancestors 'self' defp security_policy_for(:dashboard) do # Using sameorigin + the module attr for CSP {:sameorigin, @frame_ancestors} end defp security_policy_for(:api) do {:deny, "'none'"} end defp security_policy_for(:webhook) do {:deny, "'none'"} end defp render_dashboard do """ CI Pipeline Dashboard
